output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND discount_amount > 0;
output.explanation: Counts orders with an order_date in 2025 and a discount_amount above 0. I didn't filter on status or is_revenue because the question asks for orders of any status.
